title: Road Safety Lesson
logline: A young fox learns to navigate a busy road safely with the help of a wise old owl.

characters.name: Finnley the Fox
characters.one_line_description: A curious and adventurous young fox

characters.name: Olwen the Owl
characters.one_line_description: A wise and experienced owl who teaches road safety

scenes.title: Introduction to Danger
scenes.summary: Finnley approaches a busy road and hesitates.

scenes.title: Meeting the Mentor
scenes.summary: Olwen the Owl appears and offers to teach Finnley about road safety.

scenes.title: Safe Crossing
scenes.summary: Olwen teaches Finnley how to safely cross the road.

scenes.title: Successful Crossing
scenes.summary: Finnley successfully crosses the road with Olwen's guidance.

source_idea: A young fox learns to cross a busy road safely
